step1_analysis.circuit_type: Linear Regulator (LDO) Error Amplifier and Pass Transistor
step1_analysis.description: A two-stage CMOS linear regulator consisting of a differential error amplifier (first stage) and a PMOS pass transistor (second stage). It includes an auxiliary bias network (XM1, XM3, XM5, XM7, XM10) likely used for slew-rate enhancement or fast transient response.

paper_reference.title: Area-Efficient Linear Regulator With Ultra-Fast Load Regulation

dc_gain.description: Open-loop low-frequency voltage gain of the error amplifier and pass transistor.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain of diff pair (gm * ro) + Gain of CS stage (gm * ro). Assuming gm*ro ~ 20-30 V/V per stage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard two-stage CMOS amplifier gain in 130nm technology without cascoding.

ugbf.description: Unity Gain Bandwidth Frequency where the open-loop gain crosses 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm1 / (2 * pi * Cload). With Cload = 1pF and gm1 ~ 50uS.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is highly dependent on the load capacitance and the transconductance of the input pair.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin of the open-loop response to ensure closed-loop stability.

sky130_expected.calculation: Phase at UGBF. Depends on the separation of the dominant pole (at output) and non-dominant pole (at N3).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without explicit Miller compensation, stability relies on the load capacitor acting as the dominant pole.

quiescent_power.description: Total power consumed by the regulator with no load current.

paper_reported.value: 94% current efficiency at 100mA (implies ~6mA Iq in paper)

sky130_expected.calculation: VDD * (I_tail + I_bias_network). With 1.8V and ~100uA total bias current.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist uses scaled-down transistors (W=5u), so the quiescent current will be much lower than the 100mA-capable paper design.

load_regulation.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage variation during a transient load current step.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delta Vout for a 10uA to 50uA load step.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down load step (40uA) for the scaled down pass transistor (W=5u) should yield similar proportional droop.

line_regulation.description: Change in output voltage per unit change in supply voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delta Vout / Delta VDD over 1.6V to 2.0V range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the finite output resistance of the bias current sources and the loop gain.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive testbench measuring open-loop AC characteristics (Gain, UGBF, PM), closed-loop transient load regulation, and DC line regulation. Uses Rbreak/Cbreak method to seamlessly switch between open-loop AC and closed-loop Tran/DC analyses.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Area-Efficient Linear Regulator

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u

* Include SKY130 models
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* DUT
XM1 N6 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N3 V_BIAS N6 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 V_N N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 V_AMP N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 N4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N3 V_P N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 V_AMP N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}

* Power and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Vbias V_BIAS 0 0.9
Ibias N2 0 20u

* Reference Voltage
Vref V_P 0 0.9

* Feedback Loop (Broken for AC, Closed for DC/Tran via alter)
Rbreak V_AMP V_N 1G
Cbreak V_N V_AC 1G
Vac V_AC 0 DC 0 AC 1

* Load
Iload V_AMP 0 DC 10u PULSE(10u 50u 1u 0.1u 0.1u 5u 10u)
Cload V_AMP 0 1p

.control
* 1. Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Open Loop)
ac dec 20 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(V_AMP)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(V_AMP))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugbf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbf find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
print dc_gain ugbf phase_at_ugbf

* Close the loop for Transient and DC analyses
alter Rbreak 0.1
alter Cbreak 1f

* 3. Transient Analysis (Load Regulation)
tran 10n 10u
meas tran vout_max max v(V_AMP)
meas tran vout_min min v(V_AMP)
let load_reg = vout_max - vout_min
print load_reg

* 4. DC Sweep (Line Regulation)
dc VVDD 1.6 2.0 0.01
meas dc vout_16 find v(V_AMP) at=1.6
meas dc vout_20 find v(V_AMP) at=2.0
let line_reg = (vout_20 - vout_16) / 0.4
print line_reg

quit
.endc
.end
